text: The profit associated with a product, service, or event is equal to the difference between total rev- enues and total costs as follows: Profit = Total revenues — Total costs The revenues are a function of the unit sales volume and the unit selling price, while total costs for a time period are a function of the fixed costs per period and the unit variable costs as follows: Total revenues = Unit selling price x Unit sales Total costs = Fixed costs + (Variable costs per unit x Unit sales) The equation for profit can then be expanded to include the above details of the total revenue and total cost equations as follows: Profit = Unit selling price x Unit sales — [Fixed costs + (Variable costs per unit x Unit sales)]
